crossRefs.note: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.
These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.
God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish…
Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping…

parallels.note: The children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and grew exceedingly mighty; and the…

translations.web: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.”
translations.bsb: But as for you, be fruitful and multiply; spread out across the earth and multiply upon it.”
translations.kjv: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply
translations.asv: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; Bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.
